name: Jehoshaphat
summary: A king of Judah, son of Asa, who walked in the ways of the LORD and sent teachers through Judah with the book of the law. When a great army came against him he sought the LORD, and the LORD won the battle for Judah.

key_moments.title: Teaching the Law
key_moments.description: Jehoshaphat walked in the first ways of David and took away the high places from Judah. He sent princes, Levites and priests through the cities to teach the people from the book of the law.

key_moments.title: Battle at Ramoth-gilead
key_moments.description: Jehoshaphat went to battle with the king of Israel at Ramoth-gilead, wearing his royal robes while the king of Israel went in disguise. When the Syrian chariot captains surrounded him, Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD turned them away.

key_moments.title: A Fast and a Prayer
key_moments.description: When Moab, Ammon and others came against Judah, Jehoshaphat was afraid and called for a fast. He prayed before the people, and the LORD answered through Jahaziel that the battle was God's, not theirs.

key_moments.title: Singers Before the Army
key_moments.description: Jehoshaphat appointed singers to praise the LORD ahead of the army. As they began to sing, the LORD set ambushes, and the enemy armies destroyed one another.
